title: Chapter 316 - 316 Apologize; Beg For Mercy!
content:
Chapter 316 - 316 Apologize; Beg For Mercy!

Chapter 316 - 316 Apologize; Beg for Mercy!

316 Apologize; Beg for Mercy!

This sentence… Zhu Yuanhui was stunned. He stood rooted to the ground and did not know what to do.

After a while, he stuttered, “P-President, what’s wrong?”

When the president heard Zhu Yuanhui’s voice, he was annoyed and roared. “What’s wrong? Zhu Yuanhui, you bastard, you still have the face to ask what’s wrong?! You’re supposed to be the manager of the Southern Hua Nation region, and this is how you do your job?!

“I’m asking you now, are you forcefully purchasing coffee beans in Li City?”

Zhu Yuanhui’s heart tightened slightly. He did not understand why such a small matter would alert the president.

“P-President, there might be some misunderstanding…”

Obviously, at this moment, Zhu Yuanhui thought that someone had snitched on him.

As for Lin Fan’s conversation with Zhang Daming, President Xiao Ma, and President Da Ma, he did not take it to heart.

“Misunderstanding, your *ss!” the president shouted angrily.

“President Zhang from Alphabet, President Ma from Penguin, President Ma from Little Tanuki, and Mr. George Davis, the president of our head office, all called me!”

Buzz!

After hearing this, Zhu Yuanhui seemed to have been electrocuted, and his entire person completely froze.

At this moment, the scene of Lin Fan answering those calls was like a movie that played in his mind.

It was true… Lin Fan was really on the phone with Zhang Daming, President Xiao Ma, President Da Ma, and the president of Magpie Coffee.

He was really the shareholder of Alphabet, Penguin, Little Tanuki, and Magpie Coffee…

Yet, he was still mocking him…

It was over…

He was completely done for!

At this moment, the president’s angry voice came from the phone again. “Zhu Yuanhui, I’m telling you, you’d better have an explanation for this! Otherwise, I can guarantee that you won’t just lose your job!”

Then, the phone rang with a busy tone.

The busy tone seemed to drain all of Zhu Yuanhui’s strength. He could not even hold his phone and dropped it to the ground.

It was not as simple as losing his job…

Zhu Yuanhui knew that the president was not joking.

In the past, the company had been lax in its management, and he had been very secretive, so no one had found out.

However, these things definitely could not withstand close inspection…

In addition, the president also had a powerful network. Even if his deeds went undiscovered, his life would definitely not be easy after he left…

As Zhu Yuanhui thought about it, his entire face gradually turned pale. His body went limp, and he fell to the ground.

He happened to land at Lin Fan’s feet.

Zhu Yuanhui suddenly thought of something and quickly prostrated on the ground, kowtowing and begging, “Sorry, Mr. Lin… I was blinded just now. I actually… I actually disrespected you…

“I’m sorry… I’m sorry…

“Mr. Lin, if you’re angry, you can hit me or kick me…”

As he spoke, he hugged Lin Fan’s leg and kept kicking his own face.

Zhu Yuanhui had given up all his dignity to beg for Lin Fan’s forgiveness.

It was because he knew that only Lin Fan could save him.

Moreover, Zhu Yuanhui knew that Lin Fan was a super big shot who had hidden very well. It was not too much to apologize to a big shot.

Ah Mei, who was aside, looked at Zhu Yuanhui’s pitiful appearance and could not bear it anymore. She said, “Uh… Brother…”

Lin Fan patted Ah Mei’s little head. Then, he looked at Zhu Yuanhui with cold eyes and said, “Hurry up and get lost!”

Zhu Yuanhui’s heart trembled, and he said in a panic, “M-Mr. Lin…”

“Get lost! Otherwise, I can guarantee that your ending will be even more miserable than you can imagine!” Lin Fan shouted.

Lin Fan would never show any mercy to someone who had designs on his woman and threatened him!

If he did not have such a powerful force, what would have happened today?

Zhu Yuanhui knew that he was really done for…

He did not dare to say anything more. He walked out like a corpse.

The two men in suits who had been following behind him understood that Lin Fan’s identity was extraordinary.

They bowed to Lin Fan before walking out of the house with nervous hearts.

As the cars outside roared and sped away into the distance, the village finally regained its peace.

Lin Fan smiled. “I spoke so much just now. My mouth is a little dry… Ningjing, let’s go to the mountain and get some fruit to quench our thirst.”

“Alright!” Su Ningjing said happily.

“I want to go too!” Ah Mei said excitedly.

Grandma stopped her. “Ah Mei, I still have something for you to do. Don’t go with them.”

“Alright…” Ah Mei said.

Lin Fan smiled and held Su Ningjing’s hand as they walked out.

The two of them walked together on the winding path, waded through the clear stream, climbed trees to pick fruits, picked flowers, and caught butterflies…

Then, they sat together on the green field, leaning against each other.

Looking at the mountains in the distance, breathing in the sweet air around them, feeling the unique warmth of his lover… Everything was so beautiful.

At this moment, an old man carrying firewood slowly walked past the mountain road in the distance.

His skin was tanned, and his back was bent… As the firewood on his shoulder was too heavy, he could not help but stop to catch his breath and rest for a long time.

This scene seemed to have touched a certain chord in Lin Fan’s heart.

He could not help but say, “Ningjing, let’s bring Grandma and Ah Mei to live in the city.”

Su Ningjing was a little silent. For a moment, she did not know how to answer.

Lin Fan continued, “The air in the mountains is good. There’s no fighting, and the people here are very simple. But what if Grandma falls sick again? Also, Ah Mei is still young. She shouldn’t be trapped in the mountains. She should experience life in the city and enjoy a better life and education…”

Su Ningjing was silent for a while before saying, “Lin Fan, you have a point.”

Lin Fan smiled and nodded.

12:00 PM!

The red packets were here!

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received five yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 19 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 9,999 yuan.”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 18,888 yuan.]

Lin Fan tapped the screen a few times and received a total of 57,832 yuan.

Lin Fan did not even look at the money and threw the phone back into his pocket.

“Sister, Brother! Come back home for dinner!”

Ah Mei’s loud voice sounded from afar.

Lin Fan replied, “Alright, we’re coming!”
